text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickeyâ Luckyâ Happy Holidays!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Oi Racecourse at night♪ It's nice to come here to have fun once in a while instead of just racing, right?☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer is still out buying drinks...
Guess I'll just look at the scenery by myself for a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The Tokyo Daishoten is coming up soon...
Once Christmas is over, right here...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(But why did I want to beat
Acc-chan and Tarumae
so badly?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (Running neck and neck was enough to prove the power of feng shui. Was that just pure competitive spirit? Or...)

text_block_list.name: Lonely Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Even though it's Christmas,
I'm all alone. My love life really is totally hopeless, huh."

text_block_list.name: Lonely Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I guess I just can't compete with naturally cute girls
or refined young ladies after all...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Duo A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's the end of the year already, huh? I'd love to
run in the Tokyo Daishoten just once~.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Duo B
text_block_list.text:
Stop dreaming, I'm telling you. In the end,
the only ones who make it are the talented ones.
Whether they're early bloomers or late bloomers.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(There are so many different Umamusume...
Truly, so many different kinds... But all of them...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
I see, that's what it means!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I felt I had to win.
Not just run alongside them, but surpass them."
choice_data_list: Sorry to keep you waiting, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I handed over the drinks I bought,
and the two of us decided to take a stroll around the area.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so pretty☆
So this is what Oi Racecourse and the area around it
look like for Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: What was it called? Tokyo Mega Illumination?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Winter at Ohi. On non-race days, the venue is gorgeously illuminated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tokyo Mega Illumi is the centerpiece winter event
hosted by Oi Racecourse."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Looking at this glow makes me think...
this is truly what "Urban Feng Shui" is all about.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the area around the racetrack
is usually a bit dreary, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The desire to "create evening entertainment" and "create lively energy" gave birth to night races and these illuminations.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Behind that lies a multitude of feelings.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This, too, is a reflection of human life.
Every single glimmer holds meaning...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right in the middle of her feng shui explanation,
Copano Rickey suddenly fell silent for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
Isn't this kinda boring?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We came all this way to hang out, and you're lecturing me on feng shui?
You could do that literally anytime!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So today—no feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll seal away all the fortune-telling and directional readings.
Is it alright if I just empty my head and have fun?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course that's fine, but...
Yeah, of course, that's fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right☆ Then today I'll just do
whatever comes to mind♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps as a reaction to a string of grueling races,
Copano Rickey seemed eager to let loose.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "First up is Christmas dinner☆ When it comes to ordering stylish dishes, leave it all to me!"

text_block_list.name: Restaurant Staff
text_block_list.text: Um... everything won't fit on the table...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh, the special plate is this big!?
And I ordered one of every kind, too~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The scenery around here is pretty nice too.
Shall we walk for a bit, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I felt just like an Umamusume from a dreamland...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRASH-BASH-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaah, what's this~? Why is there
a cleaning set left in a place like this~?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... If only I had Feng Shui,
things wouldn't have turned out like this~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wh-What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Without feng shui... are you just a klutz?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's not true~! There's no way...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I can put together a Christmas full of romance just fine, you know!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Keep up with me, Trainer!
We're gonna turn this around right now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BZZZZZZT!)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Owwwwwwwwww☆!????

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Copano Rickey carried on the uproar after that. It turned into a delightful Christmas that showed a whole new side of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Copano Rickey kept making a big fuss. She showed me a delightful side of herself tucked away behind all that feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the way home—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer.
Those stones being sold at that stall...
choice_data_list: Is something wrong with that stone?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Lapis lazuli from Central Asia.
It holds an immense power.
Why would something like that be...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Did it just drift over by chance?
It's harboring an incredible amount of happy power, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking at the price tag—it certainly wasn't cheap. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Copano Rickey says so, it must be that valuable.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why are you buying it for me!?
Something this valuable...
choice_data_list: Just a little Christmas present, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's not just a little thing at all...
It's super rare, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—This good luck power...
If it were to be used the wrong way...
choice_data_list: I won't get it wrong— Rickey never makes mistakes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was confident in that. No matter how formidable the opposing force might be, Copano Rickey would—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"They will surely use it the right way and bring
happiness to everyone. No matter how powerful it is, I can entrust it to them."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...You really believe in me, don't you?
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll accept this Christmas present.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't keep the good luck you gave me to myself, Trainer.
My happiness is everyone's happiness♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Copano Rickey held the Christmas present package high above her head, and—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Qi, reach out! Reach everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The night sky instantly turning into a sea of stars...
Must've just been my imagination. But still...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's desire for everyone's happiness
was undoubtedly spreading far and wide.
